content.text: Two bugs found: witness/minimality masks used `covered & ~T[i]` instead of the OR over the *other* literals, and the count didn't apply the prefix filter. Let me fix both:

cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('netnomos/learners/hittingset.py')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''def _lowest_set_bit(value: int) -> int:
    """Index of the lowest set bit of a positive Python int."""
    return (value & -value).bit_length() - 1
'''
new = '''def _lowest_set_bit(value: int) -> int:
    """Index of the lowest set bit of a positive Python int."""
    return (value & -value).bit_length() - 1


def others_mask(clause, index: int, literal_masks: list[int]) -> int:
    """Union of the truth masks of every clause literal except ``index``.

    This is the truth set of the clause with literal ``index`` removed, so it is
    the right quantity for inclusion minimality and for "only true literal"
    evidence: a plain ``covered & ~literal`` mask silently drops the windows on
    which the removed literal is true alongside another one.
    """
    union = 0
    for position, literal in enumerate(clause):
        if position != index:
            union |= literal_masks[literal]
    return union


def is_inclusion_minimal(clause, literal_masks: list[int], full: int) -> bool:
    """Does dropping any single literal stop the clause covering everything?"""
    for index in range(len(clause)):
        if others_mask(clause, index, literal_masks) == full:
            return False
    return True
'''
assert old in t
t = t.replace(old, new)
old_check = '''            if next_covered == full_train:
                clause = chosen + (candidate,)
                for literal in clause:
                    if (next_covered & ~train_masks[literal]) == full_train:
                        break
                else:
                    truth = 0
                    for literal in clause:
                        truth |= universe_masks[literal]
                    if truth != full_universe:
                        found.append((clause, truth))
                continue'''
new_check = '''            if next_covered == full_train:
                clause = chosen + (candidate,)
                if is_inclusion_minimal(clause, train_masks, full_train):
                    truth = 0
                    for literal in clause:
                        truth |= universe_masks[literal]
                    if truth != full_universe:
                        found.append((clause, truth))
                continue'''
assert old_check in t
t = t.replace(old_check, new_check)
p.write_text(t)
EOF
